description: Portfolio Builder Deployment Shard Registry. Defines shared and dedicated hosting infrastructure pools.

shards.name: GitHub Pages Static Pool 01
shards.description: Primary shared static hosting shard for Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS templates.

shards.name: Cloudflare Pages Static Pool 01
shards.description: High-bandwidth global edge shard for heavy static sites, client-side Three.js 3D demos, and static SPAs.

shards.name: Netlify Static Pool 01
shards.description: Secondary static pool for pre-built SPA demonstrations.

shards.name: Vercel Managed Runtime Pool 01
shards.description: Dedicated pool for Next.js SSR, React Server Components, and Server Actions.

shards.name: Cloudflare Workers Edge Pool 01
shards.description: Serverless edge compute pool for real-time rendering, WebSockets, or edge SSR.

shards.name: Contributor-Hosted Independent Nodes
shards.description: Decentralized node pool hosted on contributors' own free-tier infrastructure (Vercel, Netlify, custom domains).
